data.rationale: The proposal gets the right goal and sequence (Bridges & Tunnels, then Tolls by vehicle, then a vehicle-type tile) and the vehicle-type parameter, but it hedges between two entry paths, misses the facility parameter, and gives vague navigation ("Fares & Tolls"), so an automation would have to guess at some steps.
